title: When We Had The Farm (Chas and Wilma McIvor)
style: Zimbabwean mbira folk urban grooves acoustic guitar hosho shakers ngoma drums warm baritone female vocal duet 82bpm analog tape warm storytelling Shona heritage farm memory Australia
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — Chas]
When we had the farm the days started before the light
The cattle needed feeding and the fences needed right
Attention and the water pump required its daily prime
When we had the farm it was a different kind of time

[Verse 2 — Wilma]
When we had the farm I knew every corner of the ground
I knew where the good soil was and where the rock was found
I knew what the sky meant before the radio could say
When we had the farm I read the weather every day

[Chorus — Both]
When we had the farm, when we had the farm
The red dust in the evening and the stars without alarm
When we had the farm, when we had the farm
We were younger and we had no idea of the charm
That it would carry forward in the memory of what's ours
The gardens still growing

[Bridge — Chas]
We don't have the farm now and the farm is someone else's
But what we built there lives inside our family's shelves
Of memory — in Corey's practical hands
And in Joel's quiet steady understanding of the lands
And in Pete's ability to read what's coming from the water

[Outro — Both]
When we had the farm… we had everything we needed…
The gardens still growing
